algorithm: For each integer i from 1 to sqrt(n), check if i divides n evenly
If i divides n evenly, add i and n//i to the list of divisors
Sort the list of divisors in ascending order
If generator=True, return the list as an unordered generator instead of a sorted list
constraints: n must be a positive integer <= 5000
divisors returns a sorted list by default (ascending order from 1 to n)
generator=True returns an unordered generator of divisors
divisor_count uses default modulus=1 and proper=False (not implemented here)
The function does not handle negative numbers or non-integer inputs
edge_cases: n=0: not allowed (n is positive integer)
output: If generator=False (default): sorted list of all positive divisors of n from 1 to n. If generator=True: unordered generator of all positive divisors of n
purpose: Return all positive divisors of n sorted in ascending order by default, or an unordered generator if generator=True
